description: The widely published 2001 photograph showing Prince Andrew with his arm around the waist of a teenage Virginia Roberts (later Virginia Giuffre), with Ghislaine Maxwell standing behind them in a doorway. The photo is reported to have been taken at Maxwell's London townhouse and became central evidence in Giuffre's allegations against Prince Andrew in the Jeffrey Epstein case. Andrew has questioned the photograph's authenticity.
flags: Prince Andrew has publicly disputed the authenticity of this photograph

description: Paparazzi-style beach photograph of a shirtless middle-aged man in dark swim shorts holding hands and standing close to a young woman in a bikini and white cap; rocks and water in the background and a partially visible third person at right. The man appears to be Prince Andrew, matching widely published press photos from a 2001 holiday in Thailand. The woman is not identified. The filename indicates the image was served by The Telegraph.
flags: Identification of Prince Andrew based on resemblance to widely published press photos; location/date inferred, not shown
Woman is unidentified and treated as a private individual

description: Photograph of former President Bill Clinton seated in an empty airport waiting area in a yellow shirt while a young blonde woman in a navy sweatshirt kneels on the seats behind him massaging his shoulders. The image, watermarked MEGA, was widely published in 2020 and reported to have been taken in 2002 at an airport stopover in Portugal during a trip on Jeffrey Epstein's jet; press reports identified the woman as Chauntae Davies, an Epstein accuser who released the photo.
flags: Identification of the woman and the location/date come from press reporting on this photo, not from the image itself

description: Product photograph of a Mickey Mouse analog wall clock on a white background, consistent with an Amazon product listing image (the Amazon Echo Wall Clock Disney Mickey Mouse Edition, which shows red LED tick marks near the top as seen here). Mickey Mouse stands at the center of a pale yellow sunburst dial and his gloved arms serve as the clock hands, pointing to roughly 10 and 2. A small Disney copyright mark appears near the bottom of the dial.
